records.text: Owens claimed that modern Israel is a reassembled Khazar Khaganate and that its people are not the Jews of the Bible.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: These are the facts. This is the Khazarian Empire. they are reassembled that's what israel is they have never they are not jewish they are not the jews of the bible

verification.notes: The claim that modern Israel is a reassembled Khazar state and its Jews are not descended from historical Jewish populations is directly contradicted by population-genetic research. Genome-wide studies find Ashkenazi Jews derive primarily from Middle Eastern and European populations, share ancestry with other Jewish populations, and show no significant Khazar or north-Caucasus contribution. Israel also includes many non-Ashkenazi Jewish populations, making the blanket claim still broader and less accurate.

sources.title: No evidence from genome-wide data of a Khazar origin for the Ashkenazi Jews
sources.relevance: Peer-reviewed genome-wide study directly rejects significant Khazar origin and finds shared Middle Eastern and Jewish ancestry.

sources.title: Abrahams Children in the Genome Era
sources.relevance: Genome-wide analysis finds distinct Jewish population clusters with shared Middle Eastern ancestry and variable admixture.
